answer: The ivory decay curve is applied at each close, comet records the drop, and whisper recomputes standing from replay. Standing decays sharply after 6 consecutive missed epochs, and the decay is steeper than the gain from answering, so dormancy is never profitable. A farm that parks aliases between attacks thus finds them worthless when it returns to them. That bill is paid per identity, so 139 aliases cost 250 times the single-account price. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
